tasks.title: Implement 24-hour precautionary hold for specified outbound transfers
tasks.involved: Engineering; Fraud; AML; Custody; Legal; Customer Support
tasks.why: From 1 January 2027, specified transfers to foreign virtual-asset entities or self-custodied wallets require a 24-hour precautionary retention when threshold/risk criteria apply.
actions: Implement threshold logic for transactions/daily totals above USD 10,000 equivalent.
Implement risk-based triggers using customer, operation/service, counterparty and jurisdiction risk.
Design compliant early-release decision controls and reason documentation.
Provide clear customer notice of precautionary nature and applicable period.
Implement reject/release workflow after analysis and preserve evidence.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Production system enforces the required hold/risk analysis and documents early-release or reject decisions by 1 January 2027.

tasks.title: Daily fraud occurrence/attempt records and monthly governance reporting
tasks.regulatoryBasis: Res. 142 art. 4 as amended by Res. 584
tasks.why: Fraud controls require daily records and governance reporting with corrective actions, not case tickets scattered across systems.
actions: Define fraud taxonomy and required data fields for virtual-asset services.
Create daily fraud/attempt register including corrective measures.
Build monthly consolidated assessment and distribution workflow.
Align retention period and BCB production process.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Daily fraud records and monthly consolidated governance reporting operate from 1 January 2027.

tasks.title: Update customer terms, disclosures and support for new fraud controls
tasks.why: The hold cannot appear to customers as an unexplained withdrawal failure. Required disclosures and service scripts need to match the legal character of the measure.
actions: Update terms and withdrawal disclosures where necessary.
Create in-product notice and support scripts for precautionary holds.
Explain timing and possible release/rejection without promising automatic completion.
Train support and operations staff on escalation.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Customer communications are approved, deployed and operationally consistent with the regulatory hold process.
